# HubbardModelVariationalAnsatz

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A variational trial wavefunction specifically designed to capture the physics of the Hubbard model, including electron correlation and magnetic ordering. This concept provides a concrete testbed for evaluating how topology-centric computing can accelerate quantum simulations of strongly correlated electron systems.
